title: RepoShapley: Shapley-Enhanced Context Filtering for Repository-Level Code Completion
authors: Yu Huo; Kun Zeng; Siyu Zhang; Yuquan Lu; Cheng Yang; Yifu Guo; Xiaoying Tang
why_relevant: Proposes coalition-aware context filtering using Shapley values to remove harmful/conflicting retrieved chunks and control when to retrieve, directly addressing noisy retrieval and retrieval control in RAG.
